extracted.name: Creamy Vanilla Fruit Dip
extracted.description: This fruit dip with Cool Whip uses just 4 ingredients to make a smooth, sweet, and fluffy treat that is perfect for dipping fresh fruit and cookies.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: Beat cream cheese and confectioners' sugar in a medium bowl with an electric mixer until well combined. Stir in vanilla. Fold in whipped topping. Chill dip in the refrigerator for 1 hour before serving.
